allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The spirited Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto, is a skilled ninja who possesses the same brashness and passion his father once had. However, the constant absence of his father, who is busy with his Hokage duties, puts a damper on Boruto's fire. He ends up meeting his father's friend Sasuke, and requests to become... his apprentice!? The curtain on the story of the new generation rises!

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can training under his father's closest friend help Boruto step out from the Seventh Hokage's looming shadow?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Frustrated by the constant absence of his father, Seventh Hokage Naruto, skilled ninja Boruto Uzumaki seeks out Naruto's longtime friend Sasuke and asks to become his apprentice as a new generation steps forward.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting, this animated fantasy keeps the emotional stakes accessible and lively for an effortless watch with friends or family.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Hiroyuki Yamashita delivers a fast, vibrant ninja adventure that balances playful humor, family friction, and kinetic fantasy action across a crisp 95 minutes.
